about: Unitree Dex1-1 at full opening: unitree_ros b579bbe, robots/g1_description/g1_29dof_mode_15_with_dex1_1.urdf (BSD-3-Clause): left_dex1_finger_joint_1/2 prismatic -0.02..0.0245 m, q 24.5 mm.  The body is Dex1_base_link.STL (the motor, the rails and the wrist adapter; not a closed surface, decimated all the same).  The Library mesh is Dex1_finger_link_1.STL; the other finger, Dex1_finger_link_2, is that finger turned 180 degrees about the approach axis (median 0.028 mm), so its sensor is the same board.
